issues.explanation: Ep2 says the board wants Adrian to marry into Vanessa's family money, implying no prior engagement, while Ep3 has Vanessa claiming a two-year engagement that ended last spring. These could both be true if the engagement ended and the board still pushes the match, so this is weak.
issues.suggested_fix: No change needed; optionally add a line in Ep2 or Ep3 acknowledging the past engagement.
